location_service.options: Dual-mode: 1) Automatic GPS/IP location detection with permission prompt, 2) Manual searchable country and city dropdown selector with flag icons.

instant_translation_engine.scope: Free instant text translation available on: 1) Every profile bio description, 2) Every incoming/outgoing direct message in chat with target language selection.
instant_translation_engine.ui_behavior: Click 'Translate' button with sparkle icon -> shows translated text inline with original toggle, detected language tag, and 'Translated by PolyglotAI' indicator.

direct_messaging_console.features: Real-time chat, active conversation list, icebreaker prompt generator ('Ask about favorite foods in Tokyo', etc.), message status (Sent, Read), photo attachment preview, and one-click translation.

frontend_components.purpose: Sticky crystal glass navigation with brand logo, Discover, Messages (with unread badge), Profile links, Language Filter quick toggle, and Google Auth state button.
Rich discover card displaying main photo, badge count for +5 gallery photos, Native/Fluent/Learning pills, location with flag, bio with instant translation, and Message CTA.
Lightbox carousel allowing users to browse all 6 photos (1 main + 5 gallery) in high resolution with keyboard navigation.
Complete profile management with photo manager (slots for main + 5 gallery photos), location auto-detector/manual picker, 2 known languages, up to 5 learning languages, and bio.
Direct messaging interface with message history, instant in-chat translation button on every bubble, icebreaker generator, and audio/phrase saver.
Reusable translation widget displaying source language, target language, one-click translation triggering, and original text toggle.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Fixed Stack: FastAPI backend in `backend/` and React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 frontend in `frontend/`. Do not change the stack.
2. Auth: Implement Google Sign-In with a clean simulation fallback ('One-Click Google Login / Demo Accounts') so testing without live OAuth keys works seamlessly.

3. Profile Photo Constraints: Exactly 1 Main Profile Photo + up to 5 additional gallery photos (maximum 6 total). Provide an intuitive upload/preview UI where users can set any uploaded photo as the 'Main' photo.

4. Language Rules: Maximum 2 known languages (1 tagged as Native, 1 tagged as Fluent). Up to 5 languages user wants to learn. Render distinct colorful pills (Sky for Native, Emerald for Fluent, Amber for Learning).
5. Location: Offer dual detection: 'Auto-detect Location' (using navigator.geolocation / IP mockup with friendly city/country result) AND manual Country/City dropdown selectors.

6. Free Translation: Implement instant translation for: a) Profile bio descriptions with a 'Translate Bio' button, b) In-chat message bubbles with a 'Translate' icon button. Support 15+ popular world languages (Spanish, French, Japanese, German, Hindi, Mandarin, Korean, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, etc.) using a fast mock/AI translation helper that returns accurate translations.
7. Direct Messaging: Build a robust, responsive chat console with conversation list, message status, auto-scroll to bottom, icebreaker prompts, and instant translation per message.

8. Seed Data: Seed at least 8 rich, diverse international user profiles with complete photos (main + gallery), bios in different languages (Japanese, French, Spanish, German, Hindi, etc.), locations, and language pairs to make discovery and translation immediately impressive.
9. Testing: Add `data-testid` attributes to all critical interactive elements (Google login, photo uploads, language selects, location buttons, translate buttons, chat inputs, send buttons).

10. Design Polish: Use the warm terracotta and earthy palette (#FAF8F5 background, #D9532F accent, #2A5B52 secondary), Plus Jakarta Sans headings, DM Sans body, generous spacing, and crisp rounded-2xl cards with layered shadows.
